title: vicia tenuifolia subsp. dalmatica
intro: Vicia tenuifolia subsp. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian vetch, is a perennial legume native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to support kidney and urinary health, and is believed to have antispasmodic, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of Dalmatian vetch include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Dalmatian vetch are attributed to its ability to promote diuresis, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress.
